cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: It looks like you've altered the `daemon` case, we should still error on it properly.

evidence.thread_resolution:
chrisduerr: What I've altered is the `!daemon` case, so we'd just crash when that fails.

My idea originally was that this wasn't really solely connected to IPC anymore, but on second thought we should probably keep the previous behavior.

I think the previous idea was mostly that with `daemon` it was impossible to get output to the terminal anyway, so it's fine to crash. But without `daemon` we'd try our best to at least start, even if the terminal wasn't fully functional, so users could see the error.
